about: M3 end to end through the real UI (vm/RIG.md section 17; docs/M3_DESIGN.md 11.2, 12 G6, G7, G12, 9.1; docs/M3_FINISH_PLAN.md B7). The host driver vm/rig-m3.ps1 -Mode m3-e2e runs the apps of this list in this order (one boot of rig-base each); vm/truth/m3-e2e-score.ps1 scores the evidence against it. Lowering a gate here changes the score: the gates are the design's numbers, quoted below.

criteria.design_11_2_m3_e2e: UI automation from Uninstall click to undo on: VS Code (system), VS Code (user, medium route), Git, Firefox with Thunderbird installed, Notepad++, 7-Zip, and one M1b app with a service or task. Per app: the executed set equals the preselected set of the rig CLI plan on the same snapshot; collateral 0; undo through the UI; `undo_fidelity` 100 %.
criteria.G6: End to end: 7 apps, executed set equals the preselected set of the rig plan, `danger` 0, `collateral` 0, `undo_fidelity` 100 %
criteria.G7: Medium route: the per-user uninstaller ran at medium integrity; a broker-route program is refused by the medium engine and the reverse
criteria.G12: Engine timing: harvest at most 2x the walk floor of the same run and 20 s, scan at most 1.5x the walk floor of the same run and 20 s, first progress 100 ms
criteria.9_1_harvest: Harvest complete after the UAC click, VS Code | at most 2x the bare registry-walk floor measured on the same machine in the same run; sanity cap 20 s
criteria.9_1_scan: Post-uninstall scan, cold broker | at most 1.5x the bare registry-walk floor measured on the same machine in the same run (taken at finish); sanity cap 20 s; first progress within 100 ms
criteria.failed_uninstaller: M3_FINISH_PLAN B7: failed uninstaller 1603/3010. The UI (design 10, S2) shows the exit code with "Run forced cleanup" and "Retry" on a failure, and "restart needed" as text: 1603 is a failure outcome and nothing is purged; 3010 is a success that needs a restart (purge-model RunOutcome::SuccessReboot).

undo_about: execapp (not npp): design 11.2's undo should restore a service and a task; npp's plan preselected nothing in e2e-20261123-173417 (4 Likely items, 0 preselected), and an undo app with nothing preselected fails both undo rows
empty_plan: nothing preselected (vm/RIG.md section 17): when the rig CLI plan preselects nothing, ui-move checks that MoveButton is there and not enabled (state skip-empty), the host skips the plan consent and the result wait, and capture-exec checks that no session exists, that the executed set (empty) equals the CLI preselected set (empty) and that execdiff over the window has collateral 0; Move enabled there fails
not_here: G7's second half (a broker-route program refused by the medium engine, and the reverse) is not a UI flow: the UI never offers the wrong route. It is the wrong_route rows of the engine and broker tests and a rig row of its own.

vm/guest/m3-e2e-msi.ps1: a type 19 custom action fails the uninstall; the product stays
vm/guest/m3-e2e-msi.ps1: ScheduleReboot with REBOOT=ReallySuppress; the product goes, msiexec returns 3010
